yt_title: Your brain thinks saving a reel is doing it
caption:
Your brain thinks saving a reel is doing it. It isn't.

I had 156 saves and had done none of them. SaveSort found the 30 actually worth doing, and flagged the hype.

Download your Instagram data (Settings → Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Download your information → Some of your information → Saved → HTML), then drop the zip into SaveSort. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Sort yours free, link in bio.

#savedreels #instagramtips #productivity #aitools
